notes: Fan-speed capture: each session now records its fan RPM range.
patch_notes: HeatWatch now captures fan speed: wherever LibreHardwareMonitor exposes fan RPM (web feed first, WMI filling in when it already runs for the temperatures), each session records its fan range — the lowest and highest RPM while the game ran — shown live in the session card, in every history row, and in the session graph window. A session with no fan sensor shows a dash, never a guess, and the fan reading never triggers an extra probe on its own, so polling costs nothing extra. A fan pinned at its maximum while temperatures keep climbing is now visible next to the peaks, which is the extra evidence the repaste verdict was missing.
